summary.text: John Wells is the Democratic candidate for Missouri State Senate District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Mike Deering.
A public school educator, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has nearly 30 years of experience as a state employee.

paragraphs.text: John Wells graduated from Hickman High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri in 1992 and a graduate degree from the University of Missouri in 2008.
His career experience includes working as a public school educator.
He defeated Pablo John Los in the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, 72.5% to 27.5%.
In the survey, Wells named education as the state's most important mission and listed health care and rural internet access as priorities for rural communities.
